notes.content:

[h1][b]How to Unlock Uzume's DLC:[/b][/h1]
With the [b]Uzume Battle Entry DLC[/b], an event will occur when you access "Information" at Planeptune. Here, Uzume can now join your party!

*You must progress to Chapter 2.
*If this DLC event was already seen, it will not occur again.

notes.title: NEW DLC NOW AVAILABLE for the Hyperdimension Re;Birth series!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/254b00c671ddbdc3e078b184de46893d0e557a6d.png[/img]

Get ready to revisit Gamindustri and your favorite Goddesses! We're happy to announce SIX new DLC are NOW AVAILABLE for the Steam® versions of [i]Hyperdimension Neptunia™ Re;Birth1, Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth2, and Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth3[/i]! 

[h1][b]New [i]Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth[/i] DLC:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Survival Mode
[*] Shares Quest
[*] Giant Island
[*] Mini Island
[*] Lily-ad Dungeon
[*] Babysitter's Club - Re;Birth 1 and 2 Only!
[/list]

Check out the details below!

[h1][b]Survival Mode ($1.99)[/b][/h1] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/1ea8f4e10aeeaac1d151c3b49c3ebe50c4184a6b.png[/img]

Survival Mode DLC brings a new nonstop brawl to the games!

Wanna see who reigns supreme in survival mode? All survival mode records are stored on an online ranking system through Steam. High ranking individuals also receive additional rewards!

How to Unlock in-Game: Survival Mode will be available upon unlocking the Colosseum in their respective titles.

Additional Notes: BGM can be changed during survival mode. Players can pick the BGM or have it shuffle and play at random.

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/979132/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth1[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042040/][b]Purchase for[i] Re;Birth2[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042050/][b]Purchase for[i] Re;Birth3[/i][/b][/url]
[/list]

[h1][b]Shares Quests ($1.99)[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/0f534ebc03993118cc38489de0a1ec3234264a75.png[/img]

The Shares Quests DLC unlocks one additional quest for Planeptune, Lastation, Lowee, and Leanbox - a total of 4 brand-new quests!

How to Unlock in-Game: The Shares Quest DLC can be unlocked from Chapter 8 on your first playthrough and unlocked from the beginning of your second playthrough.

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1050090/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth1[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/354462/][b]Purchase for[i] Re;Birth2[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1050121/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth3[/i][/b][/url]
[/list]

[h1][b]Giant Island ($1.99)[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/3dc9583e00d6e584f66e6d264713f481efbd3f47.png[/img]

The Giant's Island DLC brings exactly that - an island inhabited by stronger enemies! A perfect place to relax in the sun and grind!

How to Unlock in-Game: Giant's Island can be unlocked from Chapter 2. The dungeon is unlocked through plans.

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/979133/][b]Purchase for[i] Re;Birth1[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/354463/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth2[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1050120/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth3[/i][/b][/url]
[/list]

[h1][b]Mini Island ($1.99)[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/fe8619d2e4fedefd854e6196ccab6e0754969738.png[/img]

Mini Island DLC introduces an island dungeon filled with miniature monsters, but with more experience points to gain!

How to Unlock in-Game: You can unlock the dungeon through "Plans."

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051770/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth1[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051780/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth2[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051790/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth3[/i][/b][/url]
[/list]

[h1][b]Lily-ad Dungeon ($1.99)[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/b90ff4f6ea783f401934f450f2582b77887a6ad0.png[/img]

The Lily-ad Dungeon DLC allow players to explore Lily Rank specific dungeons and raise their Lily Ranks at a faster rate!

Each time you defeat an enemy or if you use items that enemies drop, your Lily Rank increases! All the enemies are also recolored in a cutesy pink fashion!

How to Unlock in-Game: Lily Dungeon will be available from Chapter 5 through "Plans".

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051771/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth1[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051781/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth2[/i][/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051791/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth3[/i][/b][/url]
[/list]

[h1][b]Babysitter's Club ($1.99)[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/ddd3ce566ac2f75f0f08fad489e3e162106eb74a.png[/img]

Originally released for [i]Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth1[/i], the Babysitter's Club DLC has made its way to [i]Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth2[/i]!

Kids can be a real pain sometimes... but not these cuties! The Babysitter's Club DLC unlocks Chibi IF and Chibi Compa for you to add to the party!

The Babysitter's Club DLC includes two playable characters:
[list]
[*] Chibi IF
[*] Chibi Compa
[/list]
Note: Characters will not be playable until you reach Chapter 2

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/354469/][b]Purchase for [i]Re;Birth2[/i] today![/b][/url]

You can find all of the DLC at our Publisher Page! Be sure to follow us for more news on our steam games!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/ideafactoryintl][b]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/ideafactoryintl[/b][/url]

notes.title: Death end re;Quest Plugs into Steam Spring 2019!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990050/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/9064fda5a4046c21a14c30a13a8c524d2e6ec028.png[/img][/url]

[b]Plug into World’s Odyssey… through your PC![/b] We are excited to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990050/][i][b]Death end re;Quest™[/b][/i][/url] will be[b] headed to Steam® this Spring[/b]! The game includes all the original game content found in the Japanese version. Steam users will also be able to [b]grab the free and paid DLC originally available in the PlayStation®4 version[/b], with the exception of the Bonus Weapon DLC (PlayStation™Network & Physical Retail Exclusives). The DLC will be available upon launch, except the Summer Swimsuit Bundle DLC, which is scheduled for June 4. As an added bonus, the [b]Steam® version will include Japanese and Traditional Chinese subtitles.​[/b]

[i]Death end re;Quest [/i]takes the classic turn-based RPG and turns it on its head. Players are able to change the game's genre and switch game modes from RPG into fighting, shooter, and even a slot mode! You'll also be able to jump at will between the in-game world and the real world to investigate your missing friend, unlocking one of multiple endings. Choose wisely as lines between fantasy and reality will begin to blur... 

[h1][b]Story[/b][/h1]

Arata Mizunashi, a video game programmer, receives a notification from an email sent to him by Shina Ninomiya, a colleague of his who went missing nearly one year ago. Together, they worked to create World’s Odyssey (W.O.D.), an immersive virtual landscape powered by breathtaking, state-of-the-art technology. That is, until Shina's sudden disappearance put a swift halt to production. Arata discovers the startling revelation that Shina Ninomiya was stuck inside of “W.O.D.” the whole time. When Arata delves hurriedly back into the lines of code haunting his forsaken project, he realizes that his game is now ravaged by an infestation of bugs, and that Shina is its only active player.
Arata soon learns that a nefarious force prevents him from extracting Shina out of the game. Her only way out? She must complete the game to unlock the perfect ending—an outcome with a success rate of 1%. On their journey, they encounter a slew of NPC characters that blur perceptions of humanity and A.I.-technology, setting into a motion a thrilling narrative that calls into question the differences between the virtual world and ours.

Little do they know what horrors await them on both sides of the screen...


[h1][b]Key Features[/b][/h1]

[b]Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction?[/b] – Jump between reality and in-game modes, as players will need to investigate in the real world view to solve the mysterious inner-workings of the World Odyssey, and switch to an in-game view mode to battle against glitched-out monsters. Successfully achieving the true ending will require players to tread carefully, as every turn can ultimately lead to disaster.

[b]Turn-Based RPGs Flipped Upside Down[/b] – In this turn-based command battle system, you can roam freely and duke it out with fearsome monsters. During battle, players can change the game’s genre from a first-person shooter to even a fighting game!

[b]You’re Buggin’ Out[/b] – While exploring, players will need to activate character-specific dungeon skills to access hard-to-reach areas and hidden treasures!

[b]Follow the White Rabbit and Discover a Bug Infested World[/b] – In this hyper-realistic game world, players must help out Shina escape a game universe filled with infected bosses and mesmerizing environments!

[h1][b]Screenshots:[/b][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990050/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/2ddb26d44461031e1e0e20fe78448bb6b58d9e63.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/21a37d33003bce72215c52842f9a3a320af75a40.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/e86c8066b46427da1ca9785f883891661d22158a.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/d23bd200038d281b2705005ae645093c772025e6.png[/img][/url]

Head to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990050/][b]Store Page[/b][/url] to add to your Wishlist today!

notes.title: Record of Agarest War Mariage comes to Steam Early 2019!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/748d1242dcc1e80af99d759fee1ddfb40b430b80.png[/img]

[b]The Hero who wields the Ciel Blade will save the world from destruction...[/b] We are excited to announce that [b][i]Record of Agarest™ War Mariage[/i][/b], originally released for the [b]PSP™[/b], will be arriving on [b]Steam® early 2019! [/b]The Steam version will also include English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.

[h1][b]About the Game[/b][/h1]

Agarest begins with a hero, who at birth, was given a difficult task in defeating the Archdemon. The society revolves around the mythos of Yiris, the Larva commonly known as the Sacred Princess, who blessed the world and fell in love with a human. Martyred for her love, she was then punished by the heavenly creator. The Archdemon arrived soon after, and Yiris’ lover pledged to destroy the evil Archdemon with the infamous Ciel Blade, a sword of rainbow.

A Hero, or Chosen One, is trusted to produce an heir that can at last put an end to the Archdemon once and for all.

[h1][b]Key Features[/b][/h1]

[b]True Love Waits[/b] - Begin the story as the first generation protagonist Rain, where players will have the chance to choose from various bachelorettes. The story's path will change depending on the girl you choose! The story extends through two generations with each new protagonist inheriting stats and abilities from their parents.

[b]Up-Close and Personal[/b] - The Unification System allows players to unlock special interactive CGs when reaching a certain Heart Level with your love interest. The higher the Heart Levels, the more intimate the experience! Earn your partner’s trust for your chance to inspect your partner’s pleasure spots that will ultimately unlock new abilities and weapons!

[b]Class Is In Session[/b] - Assign your party members as an Attacker, Defender, Healer, or Supporter. Choose to upgrade a specific class for your character to unlock multiple strategic opportunities!

[b]Custom Kawaii Outfits For All[/b] - Craft various outfits for your party members by using items picked up from enemy forces and the local shop! Check yourself out in a 360 degree viewable gallery!

[b]*More information and store page coming soon![/b]

tags.feature: The Steam version will also include English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.
